notes.title: Receive a gift during early access
notes.notes:
Everyone who plays the game at least once during Early Access will receive a very special gift
This gift will appear highly in your steam inventory, and can be opened from the in-game inventory menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166150/b5ee096098dd7a03412b764ae6547aad0ba12e29.png[/img]
After opening this gift you will receive 5 stars that can be used in the future to purchase items in the store and the new character: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166150/774af4139ba507d3b89c9691571833ba72c64067.png[/img]
A.R.K n01-D, a little robot with high energy capacity that transforms the gameplay of the game into a different and challenging experience.

Enjoy this gift as a reward for supporting the game during early access.

notes.title: Introducing Steam Inventory Integration
notes.notes:
Spirit Bounce will have a series of collectibles that can be traded and sold on the community market, and can be obtained for free using an in-game currency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166150/42df31f81c6307880bb7454537962613585425d6.png[/img]

In this post I'll explain a little about Spirit Bounce features with Steam Inventory, through which players can receive rewards for playing the game daily, completing achievements, or buying in the store.

First of all the most basic items are Stardust and Stars, for every 6 minutes of gameplay you receive a Stardust, you can receive a maximum of 10 per day, when you have 10 Dust they will be automatically exchanged for a Star.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166150/c896e79d568ddeaa01cdfd197197de31cbf784bb.png[/img]

With the stars you can buy any item in the in-game shop, there are 4 types of items: Pets, Eggs, Hats and Characters:

[b]Eggs [/b]can be traded and sold in the community market, you can also open an egg to receive a random colored pet of a specific pet species.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166150/311a86d3b95993f879a5240fb93c62c4cba41cd2.png[/img]

[b]Pets[/b] can be equipped, your character will receive an attribute bonus depending on the species of pet you are using, for example the seahorse increases 1 stamina and the salamander 1 speed.
Pets can have 6 different colors and 3 common colors, two rare, and one exotic. You can also equip a[b]hat[/b] on your pet to customize its look a bit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166150/047ce735902e2d7b9fc0356ef3c1b96d9993f86a.png[/img]

After playing 50 levels with the same pet, it can evolve releasing a new ability, after evolving a pet it can no longer be sold or traded with other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166150/ead84624524fb8d873f0d227299de701ed010683.png[/img]

Finally, [b]Character[/b] items release a new character for you to use in any game, these items also cannot be traded or sold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166150/774af4139ba507d3b89c9691571833ba72c64067.png[/img]

That's all I have to share for today, I hope you enjoyed the news and really enjoy the item system when Spirit Bounce comes out.

notes.title: Play Test Running this weekend
notes.notes:
This weekend we will be running a playtest of the game where everyone can participate.
The main objective of this playtest is to check which levels the players like the most and which ones are too difficult. to balance the problematic levels to make the game even more enjoyable.

To participate simply request access using the button on the game page on steam.

Please take the weekend to test the game and send your opinion, for example which levels you liked best or those that seem boring.

The Level Editor is also available, I would love to see your creations.

notes.title: Level editor integrated with steam workshop
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that community levels will be available right at the beginning of early access, and best of all: integrated with the steam workshop.

This functionality is working very well in the beta test. 
Soon you will also be able to create, share and discover new Levels every day.
